enums.name: ObjectTransformFlags
enums.comment: obj_tag::transformFlags (0xd6): how the update derives an object's matrix and bounds each frame - Control_GetObjMatrix 0x2cf10, Control_BuildWorldSph 0x2db20, control_movement_object_handler 0x2dd10, Player_Update. Ordinarily the matrix is rebuilt from rotation, position and scale, and the bounding sphere from the model. 0x10 is set on particle-emitter objects (no reader found); 0x80 is not traced. src/action/game/obj/object.h

values.name: TRANSFORM_SCALE_LENGTH_ONLY
values.comment: scale stretches along the object's Z only (beams, lasers, tracers), not evenly

values.name: TRANSFORM_KEEP_ROTATION
values.comment: the matrix's rotation is set elsewhere and kept; only its translation comes from position

values.name: TRANSFORM_MATRIX_PLACED
values.comment: the whole matrix is set elsewhere and kept (Player_Update stops putting position into it too); with 0x02, the last rotation comes from the matrix's direction

values.name: TRANSFORM_ANIMATED
values.comment: skinned, animated object (AnimObjectNew): bounding sphere from the animation, not the model; collision and the view code test it

values.name: TRANSFORM_MOVED
values.comment: moved this frame: control_movement_object_handler wraps the rotation, rebuilds matrix, world bounds, cel and lighting, keeps position and rotation as the last ones

values.name: TRANSFORM_POSITION_FROM_MATRIX
values.comment: after the frame's update, the position is read back out of the matrix's translation

values.name: TRANSFORM_FIXED_RADIUS
values.comment: the radius is kept as set, not worked out from the model and scale

values.name: TRANSFORM_NO_SCALE
values.comment: scale is not applied to the matrix

values.name: TRANSFORM_REFERENCED
values.comment: others may point at it: on deletion, bullets, explosions and hit lists referring to it are cleared

types.name: obj_tag
types.comment: A game object. Rebuilt here only to rename and retype 0xd6 (was rendererType, a guess); every other field is as it was. src/action/game/obj/object.h

fields.name: transformFlags
fields.comment: how the update derives the matrix and bounds; was rendererType
